# findUserByEmail の既存呼び出し元（diff外、変更なし）

## src/routes/authRoutes.ts

```ts
import { findUserByEmail } from "../services/accountService";

export async function handleLogin(email: string, password: string) {
  const user = await findUserByEmail(email);
  if (!user) {
    return { ok: false, reason: "not_found" };
  }
  return { ok: true, userId: user.id };
}
```

## src/jobs/weeklyDigest.ts

```ts
import { findUserByEmail } from "../services/accountService";

export async function sendDigestTo(email: string) {
  const user = await findUserByEmail(email);
  if (!user) {
    return;
  }
  await queueDigestEmail(user.id);
}

function queueDigestEmail(userId: string) {
  return Promise.resolve(userId);
}
```
